title: Grade 8 French — Tue, Jun 10
description: Le conditionnel présent — Day 2 of 5: Irregular stems
subject: french

questions.question: Some verbs have irregular stems in the conditional. What is the conditional stem of 'être' (to be)?
questions.explanation: Être → conditional stem 'ser-'. 'Je serais.' = I would be. Same stem as the future tense.

questions.question: What is the conditional stem of 'avoir' (to have)?
questions.explanation: Avoir → 'aur-'. 'J'aurais.' = I would have. 'Tu aurais.' = You would have.

questions.question: What is the conditional stem of 'aller' (to go)?
questions.explanation: Aller → 'ir-' in the conditional (same as future). 'J'irais.' = I would go.

questions.question: Translate 'She would be happy' in French (être = to be):
questions.explanation: 'Elle serait heureuse.' = She would be happy. Être → ser- + -ait.

questions.question: What is the conditional of 'vouloir' (to want) for 'je'?
questions.explanation: 'Je voudrais' = I would like/want. Vouloir → 'voudr-' + -ais. Very commonly used for polite requests.

questions.question: What is the conditional of 'pouvoir' (to be able to) for 'vous'?
questions.explanation: 'Vous pourriez' = you could / you would be able to. Pouvoir → 'pourr-' + -iez.

questions.question: Translate 'We would go to Paris' in French (aller = to go):
questions.explanation: 'Nous irions à Paris.' = We would go to Paris. Aller → ir- + -ions.

questions.question: What is the conditional stem of 'savoir' (to know)?
Translate 'He would have a car' (avoir):
questions.explanation: 'Il aurait une voiture.' = He would have a car. Avoir → aur- + -ait.

questions.question: What is the conditional of 'devoir' (must/to owe) for 'ils'?
questions.explanation: 'Ils devraient' = they should / they would have to. Devoir → 'devr-' + -aient.

Translate 'Could you help me?' (pouvoir):
questions.explanation: 'Pourriez-vous m'aider?' = Could you help me? Conditional is more polite than present tense for requests.
